items.text:
A roofer told me he loses about two jobs a week to voicemail.

Not to a competitor's better price. To voicemail.

He is on a roof. The phone rings. He cannot answer it. The caller does not leave a message, because almost nobody does. They ring the next roofer on the list.

The job was never lost on price or on quality. It was lost because nobody picked up.

I build voice agents that answer those calls, take the name, number, job and address, and text them to the owner within a minute. The owner rings back when they are off the roof, and the caller is still theirs.

If you run a trade and the phone goes unanswered while you work, that is the whole problem worth fixing.

A lot of tradespeople tell me the same thing about AI answering: "My customers won't want to talk to a robot."

Fair worry. But the comparison I'd ask you to make isn't AI versus you. It's AI versus voicemail.

When you're on the tools, the call that goes unanswered isn't answered by you. It goes to a beep, and plenty of callers hang up and ring the next number.

So what would you rather the caller got? A beep, or something that asks what the job is, takes their number and tells them you'll ring back?

If a caller asks whether it's an AI, it says yes. It doesn't quote prices or promise dates. Those stay with you.

Where do you land on that?

Be honest. When you're up a ladder and the phone rings, what happens to that call?

It goes to voicemail. And plenty of callers don't leave a message. They just ring the next tradesperson on Google.

You can't be in two places at once. That's not a failing, it's the job.

So what do you do about it right now? Partner answers, mate answers, or it just rings out?

"My customers won't want to talk to a robot."

Fair enough. I hear it a lot from tradespeople.

But think about what actually happens when you can't pick up. They don't get you. They get a beep.

Which would you rather a customer got while you're on a job: a beep, or a polite voice that asks what the work is, takes their number and says you'll ring back?

And if they ask "is this an AI?", it tells them yes. No tricks.

What would you want it to say?
